column1: # TEST-ORDER-EXCEPTIONS — test code in a shape crates/bt-source/tests/test_order.rs refuses,
# The shapes: A1 a bin located by CARGO_BIN_EXE_ outside an integration test; A2 a path derived
# from the test executable's folder with no bt_testpath name; C1 the process's directory or
# environment changed; D1 a folder or file created under the temporary folder or the build
# directory by a fixed name; D0 a module-level use of env::temp_dir or env::*. The guard holds this list to its refusals both ways: an unlisted
# refusal is red, a row that no longer refuses is red. A row says why the fixed name or the
# location is the test's subject, or what guarantees the file it reads.
